user.title: CEC TV
user.description: Control a TV over HDMI-CEC through the Kodi box plugged into it. Requires the Kodi addon script.cec.control 0.2.0 or later, and Kodi's web server (JSON-RPC) enabled. CEC works even when the TV has lost its network connection.

error.addon_missing: The addon script.cec.control is not installed in this Kodi
error.addon_disabled: The addon script.cec.control is installed but disabled
error.addon_outdated: The addon script.cec.control is too old: version 0.2.0 or later is required
